text:
marie: heads-up: staging restore failing intermittently with kms.Decrypt AccessDenied on HSM-backed CMKs (~5% failures).
dan: paste example?
marie: ops-bot: [2026-03-10T14:12:22Z] restore-423 error: kms.Decrypt AccessDenied: arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/restore-agent is not authorized to use the key (kms:Decrypt) status 403 req=abcd...
ira: do we have a proxy that issues ephemeral grants for HSM CMKs?
dan: yes, kms-proxy issues per-request grants. We flipped grant TTL from 60s->30s in canary last night to reduce live grant count.
ev: that could explain race if decrypt happens after expiry. two mitigation paths: increase TTL or implement grant-renew in restore-agent.
sec-qa: classify severity? availability now, but note potential for DoS if attacker induces long decrypt delays. marking P2.
marie: also found uploader sometimes writes decrypted snapshot metadata to /tmp during a retry failure path. risk: plaintext left on disk if process crashes. filed ticket UPLOAD-TMP-PLAIN-999.
ops-bot: [2026-03-10T14:28:10Z] ticket created UPLOAD-TMP-PLAIN-999 assigned to evan
ev: repro snippet pinned: TMPDIR=/tmp uploader --upload snap && false || cp /tmp/snapmeta-* /tmp/bugdump -> shows plaintext persists.
ira: quick patch: use O_TMPFILE or open+unlink pattern; container image musl/glibc edgecases though.
dan: IAM guardrail suggestion: deny direct kms:Decrypt for uploader role in prod; require decrypt through kms-proxy.
marie: audit improvement: include grant_id, grant_issued_at, grant_ttl_s, proxy_req_id in KMS-related logs. example event: {"event":"kms_decrypt","key_id":"arn:aws:kms:...","principal":"restore-agent","result":"AccessDenied","grant_id":"g-01","grant_issued_at":"2026-03-10T14:11:45Z","grant_ttl_s":"30","proxy_req":"p-789"}
oncall-sre: can we do emergency TTL bump? low blast radius if limited to restore aliases.
ops-bot: oncall alert sent to @oncall-sre
oncall-sre: approved temporary increase to 120s for aliases alias/staging/restore and alias/prod/restore for 30m window. monitor decrypt error rate.
dan: running staging canary: for i in 1..100 do aws kms decrypt ... || echo fail$i; sleep 0.5; done
ops-bot: [2026-03-10T14:58:30Z] canary result: 0 fails /100 after TTL bump
ev: next fix items: 1) uploader tmpfile -> O_TMPFILE PR; 2) restore-agent auto-renew on grant-expired; 3) deny direct kms:Decrypt in prod for uploader role; 4) add audit fields + 90d retention.
marie: adding runbook entry under encops-runbooks: "ephemeral-grant-decrypt-failure" with commands, alert queries, RBAC checklist.
sec-qa: request legal review for potential tmpfile exposure (possible r/o access in staging).
oncall-sre: monitor logs for repeated AccessDenied with same grant_id -> alert.
ev: created PRs for tmpfile fix and audit schema; linking to ticket.
dan: scheduling postmortem within 48h if we see recurrence.
marie: milestone: close once tmpfile fix + audit schema + RBAC allowlist merged and prod canary passes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
